title: Weekend Indian Thali at Rivayat, Oberoi Marrakech — A New Saturday-Sunday Dining Ritual
image_query: indian thali food colorful plates spices
body:
Rivayat at the Oberoi Marrakech launches a Weekend Thali Lunch every Saturday and Sunday, 12:30-15:30 PM. Michelin-starred Chef Rohit Ghai presents 8-12 dishes simultaneously — curries, dhal, bread, chutneys, raita, dessert — incorporating Moroccan seasonal ingredients.

Booking

Open to hotel guests and outside visitors. Approximately 650 MAD per person including welcome drink. Reservation essential — contact Oberoi Marrakech directly. Summer weekends fill rapidly.

Source: MadeInCity Marrakech and Oberoi Marrakech.
